create_timm_model: create a TimmModel wrapping a timm model as a CLIP vision tower with configurable pooling and projection
create_timm_model_with_attention_pooling: create a TimmModel using abs_attn or rot_attn pooling for attention-based feature extraction
lock_timm_model: lock a TimmModel trunk parameters to freeze weights during fine-tuning with optional unlocked groups
forward_timm_model: run a forward pass through the TimmModel trunk and head to get embedded features
review_timm_model_init: review the TimmModel init to understand pooling and projection layer configuration options
